about.metaDescription: A licensed local agency in Agadir with more than 20 years in the Souss-Massa region: our story, our drivers and our promise on prices and honesty.
about.title: A Souss-Massa agency, run by people who live here
about.lead: We are a licensed travel and tourist-transport agency based in Agadir. For more than twenty years we have driven this coast — from Taghazout to Tiznit, from the Souss valley to the dunes north of Tamri — and we still plan every route ourselves.
about.story1: Our founder began with a single vehicle and a phone. Season after season, guests returned and asked for the same driver, the same honest advice about when the pools at Paradise Valley run low, or which mornings the swell keeps the boats in the marina. That is still how we work: a small local team, not a call centre.
about.story2: We publish fixed prices in euros, with an indicative dirham equivalent, and we do not add hidden stops or commissions. If a price is an estimate while a partner confirms it, we say so. If something depends on the season, we say that too.
about.story3: Every excursion, activity and transfer on this site is one we run ourselves or with a partner operator we know personally, with licensed drivers and insured vehicles.
about.value1Body: Real pickup windows, real driving times and honest seasonal notes — because we drive these roads every week.
about.value2Body: Fixed EUR prices with an indicative MAD equivalent, fuel and tolls included, and no forced shopping stops.
about.value3Body: You reach a member of our local team, before and during your stay, seven days a week.
about.ctaBody: Browse the catalogue or send a request; we confirm availability and answer your questions directly.

faq.metaDescription: Answers about booking, prices, payment, pickup and cancellation for tours, activities and transfers with our Agadir agency.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: The questions we are asked most, answered plainly. If yours is not here, message us on WhatsApp.

items.a: Choose a service, send a request with your date and party size, and we confirm availability on WhatsApp. Payment is in cash (EUR or MAD) at pickup; there is no online prepayment.

items.q: Are the prices per person or per vehicle?
items.a: Tours and activities are per person, and transfers are per vehicle — car for up to 3 passengers, van for 4 to 7, minibus for 8 to 15. Each page states its unit clearly.

items.q: What is included in the price?
items.a: Hotel pickup and drop-off where stated, transport in an air-conditioned vehicle, fuel, tolls and parking. Entrance fees, meals and tips are usually not included and are listed on each page.
Transfers are free to cancel up to 12 hours before pickup, and excursions up to 24 hours before departure. Late cancellations may be chargeable on bookings that carry a deposit.

items.q: Do you pick up from Taghazout and Tamraght?
items.a: Yes. Guests in Taghazout, Taghazout Bay, Tamraght and Aourir are collected en route on north-bound excursions, and other tours can add a small pickup supplement on request.
Most services welcome families; each page lists age guidance and restrictions. Child seats are free on request with 24 hours' notice for transfers.
